title: 학력인정학교지정규칙 / queue:ADDENDUM:00001:20130323:00004:part:1/1
full_text:
Addendum to the Enforcement Rules of the Organization of the Ministry of Education and Its Affiliated Institutions <Ordinance No. 1, March 23, 2013>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
These Rules shall enter into force on the date of their promulgation. [Proviso omitted.]
Articles 2 through 6
Omitted.
Article 7 (Amendment of Other Statutes and Regulations)
(1) through (58) Omitted.
(59) Part of the Rules on Designation of Schools Recognized as Providing Academic Qualifications shall be amended as follows:
In Article 2 (1) 2, paragraph (2) of that Article, the portion of paragraph (3) of that Article other than its subparagraphs, and Article 4 (1) and (2), "Minister of Education, Science and Technology" shall in each case be replaced with "Minister of Education".
(60) and (61) Omitted.
